hero.title: Seamen's Club
hero.subtitle: Where seafarers from around the world come together.
hero.p1: At the heart of the port facilities, the Seamen's Club is a warm place built to welcome every sailor calling at the Port of Québec. Open 365 days a year, run by dedicated volunteers.
hero.p2: Whether your call is short or long, this is your home away from home ashore. We look forward to welcoming you.

photoCaption: An open door steps from the pier, whatever time you come ashore.

services.title: Services on site
services.subtitle: Free, on site, for every crew in port.

items.title: Community lounge
items.text: A living room with pool table, piano and armchairs — unwind and meet other crews.

items.title: Wi-Fi booth
items.text: A private booth for calls home and a reliable connection any time.

items.title: Convenience store
items.text: Everyday essentials, without leaving port grounds.

items.title: Clothing counter
items.text: Warm gear suited to the sometimes harsh weather waiting for you ashore.

mission.title: Far more than a place to rest
mission.p1: As a not-for-profit, the Seamen's Club meets the physical, emotional and spiritual needs of everyone working at the Port. The goal: a welcoming environment that truly feels like home.
mission.p2: Crew members, business partners and visitors alike are warmly received. It is a port community where everyone feels included and supported.

shuttle.title: The shuttle that gets you off the pier
shuttle.p1: Port grounds are no place to walk. The Seamen's Club shuttle, driven by our volunteers, takes you from the ship to the club and into town: grocery store, pharmacy, shops and Old Québec.
shuttle.p2: Book at the front desk or by phone at {phone}. Availability depends on the volunteers on duty.

donation.title: Make a donation
donation.p1: The Seamen's Club thrives on the generosity of its donors, volunteers and committed partners.
donation.p2: Every gift directly supports its activities and the welcome extended to crews.
